items.a: No. Halcott Dental Studio is invented. This build is a demonstration of a design family, published so the design can be shown without linking a real client's site or a prospect's private pitch.

items.q: I have not been to a dentist in a long time.
items.a: That is common and it is not a problem. The first visit is an examination and a conversation, and nothing is done that day unless you want it to be.

items.q: Will I know the cost before treatment?
items.a: Yes. You get a written plan with the cost on it before anything starts.
